subject: DESeq2: model inputs and coefficient testing
scope: Bounded high-level input/dependency overview of the original 2014 paper. Raw counts remain the response of the NB GLM; size factors enter the mean model. The dispersion-estimation node includes trend sharing and the outlier exception. Independent filtering, multiple-testing correction, full algorithm iteration, diagnostics, and current software defaults are outside this module.

sources.citation: Love MI, Huber W, Anders S. Genome Biology 15, 550 (2014). doi:10.1186/s13059-014-0550-8
